requirement: Importing a Joomla site built from a quickstart keeps the one contract its params name: the slim package carries the version whose files the site serves, and a still-missing contract is named contract_unavailable

oracle.invariant: S1: every test passes; a Tracy Business site under a 2 MB limit whose served template.css matches version 1.2.2 is sent a package under 2 MB holding exactly tracy-business/j6/1.2.2 and ends ok; a quickstart naming another contract keeps both; a site with no matching template keeps none; a contract still missing after the install ends install_failed with check contract_unavailable and its own sentence
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
